answer: Locks are entered in basalt, expire in kernel, and sonnet lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 9 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A hostile operator running 136 aliases as a result needs 46 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1427 identities would post 1975 proofs and burn roughly 30 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
